description: Search current news for a specific reader. Covers technology, AI, business, policy, and media and entertainment (about 500 curated sources, not all news). Returns one list of stories, best match first: events, each grouped across the outlets covering it, with every article (publisher, date, link), the lead article's excerpt, the names in it, and which of your terms it matches and how well (0 to 1). Then Polymath reports, with title, insight and link. Put topics in "interests": 3 to 8 specific topics, named the way a news desk would ("AI regulation", "data centers"). The name of a person or a company works as an interest too ("Nvidia"). Each interest gets its fair share of the list, and the reply says what each one found, including nothing. "query" is for keywords. "profile" says who you work for: it tailors reports and rarely selects stories by itself. "since" returns only what is new or updated after a time; every reply gives next_since, the value to pass next time. With no arguments it returns the top stories right now. No API key was sent, so this is a trial: 1 searches a day, up to 3 stories per search, report titles and links only.

detail.description: Less or more text. brief (default): every story with every article (publisher, date, link), the lead article's excerpt and the names in it. full: the same, plus every article's excerpt and a summary of each Polymath report.

interests.description: Three to eight specific topics this reader cares about, which you infer from the profile, for example ["AI regulation", "data centers", "Nvidia"]. Name each topic the way a news desk would. The name of a person or a company works as an interest too. Each interest gets its fair share of the results, and every story says which interests it matches and how well, so specific topics work far better than a profile alone.

max_results.description: Most stories and most reports to return, each. Default 8.

profile.description: Who you are working for, in one or two sentences, for example "a mid-size US law firm with a technology practice". The profile tailors reports. It rarely selects stories by itself, so put the topics in "interests".

query.description: Keywords or a short question, for example "EU AI Act enforcement" or "who is buying data centers".

since.description: Only what is new since this time (ISO 8601, for example "2026-11-09T07:00:00Z"). Pass the next_since value from your previous search_news reply. Overrides since_days. Stories are marked new or updated.

since_days.description: How many days back to look. Default 7 for stories and 30 for reports. Stories go back at most 30 days, reports 90.

name: search_news

names.description: The people, companies or products it matched.

reports.description: Reports in this reply that it returned.

skipped.description: True when this text was not searched because the search ran out of time. Search again.

stories.description: Stories in this reply that it returned.

via.description: How this text was matched. "search" means no topic or name matched, so keyword and meaning search ran. "none" means nothing ran.

top_stories.description: True when the list is the top stories: nothing was asked for, or only a profile that matched no topic or name.

matcher.description: Present when the results come from Polymath's own search (the default).

next_since.description: Pass as "since" on the next call to get only what is new.

id.description: The report id: pass it as report_id to request_report to have it rewritten for your reader.

matches.description: Your terms it matches, best first.

id.description: The story id, for request_report (story_id) and get_story.

matches.description: Your terms it matches, best first.

score.description: How well it matches that term, 0 to 1.

term.description: One of your terms: the query, an interest, or "your profile".

names.description: The people, companies and products it names.

publishers.description: Every publisher with an article in this story, the lead first.

report_id.description: A Polymath report on this story, when one exists: pass it as report_id to request_report.

also_covering.description: Ids of other stories on the same event that are listed with this one.

interest.description: What it matched: "your query", one of your interests, or "your profile".

topic.description: The topic label, when it was found through one.

via.description: How it was found: "topic" (a topic label, by name), "topic_by_meaning" (the nearest topic label), "entity" (a person, company or product, by name), "search" (keyword or meaning search).

outlets.description: How many outlets cover the event.

report_id.description: A Polymath report on this story, when one exists.

terms.description: Each of your terms that selected results, with what it returned.

reports.description: Reports in this reply that match it.

skipped.description: True when this term was not searched because the search ran out of time. Search again.

stories.description: Stories in this reply that match it.

top_stories.description: True when the list is the top stories: nothing was asked for, or only a profile that matched nothing.

title: Search Polymath News
